name: Koensayr
description: Koensayr was a planet in the Colonies region. It was the headquarters of Koensayr Manufacturing. A Gran colony, in addition to industrializing most of the planet, the lower latitudes contain a small, seaside tourism industry, with vibrant colorful sunsets being a standout feature.
